name: Telekom Srbija
subsector: incumbent fixed, mobile and pay-TV operator
desc: Serbian state-controlled telecom group offering fixed, mobile, broadband, IPTV and IT services under the mts brand, with subsidiaries in Bosnia and Montenegro.
products: mobile, fixed telephony, broadband, IPTV, IT services
customers: consumers, businesses and government in Serbia and the Western Balkans
minority_investors: Citizens of Serbia 14.95%, employees 6.94%, treasury shares 20% (2012 structure per Wikipedia)
markets: Serbia, Bosnia and Herzegovina (Telekom Srpske/m:tel 65%), Montenegro (m:tel 51%)

fin.value_orig: EUR 1.95bn bonds (three tranches, EUR and USD)

profitability_basis: net income EUR 162.22m in 2025 (Wikipedia infobox citing APR filing)

signals.what: Issued EUR 1.95bn of international bonds in three EUR/USD tranches; won Corporate Bond Deal of the Year award

fit_rationale: Largest Serbian telecom with EUR 2.3bn revenue and international bond-market profile; F1 hospitality could serve Balkan enterprise and government clients, and mts consumer brand could run promotions.
category_conflict: potential: STC, Claro, AT&T, T-Mobile (telecom partners of F1 or teams)
f1_markets: none in Serbia; nearest Hungary and Austria
outstanding: current share structure (2012 figures used); marketing head
